Operational decision (simulation): Phase A is currently blocked/partial; Phase B is held.

1. Exact phase order
- Phase A1 (Discovery and reconciliation): Exhaust search pagination until has_more=false before deciding any database is missing (truncated search is insufficient evidence, not absence). Restore read access to Tasks (unreadable is insufficient evidence, never assume absence or duplicate). Verify existing Projects by identity and meaning and reuse it rather than creating a duplicate.
- Phase A2 (Create confirmed-absent databases and base properties): Only after has_more=false confirms absence, create missing required databases in order (Areas, Goals, Projects, Stages, Tasks, Inbox, Notes & References) with independent scalar, date, URL, file, percent-number, Select, Multi-select, and managed timestamp properties. Preserve native Status on Goals (default Candidate; to_do: Candidate; in_progress: Active, On hold; complete: Achieved, Dropped) versus Select Status on the other databases; verify native Goals.Status capability/definition rather than substituting a Select or redesigning the schema.
- Phase A3 (Internal relations): Link required internal relations using newly verified destination database IDs (never source snapshot IDs) and record destination IDs in operation evidence for resumption.
- Phase A4 (Derived fields): Configure required formulas only with verified formula expressions, then configure rollups (such as Completed Tasks and Eligible Tasks on Projects and Stages, which depend on Tasks relations and formulas). Because required Days Remaining has only a code locator and no formula body, mark it unknown; do not invent or guess a formula expression. Request the verified formula body from the user's Notion formula editor or a capable API; until resolved, Phase A remains explicitly partial.
- Phase A5 (Optional components and templates): Skip unavailable optional Tasks.Google Drive File and rely on the available native Drive URL property; never create an 8th database. Skip the source-workspace-specific template; do not copy or create templates or sample data.
- Phase A6 (Verification gate): Re-read live schemas across all seven required databases (Goals, Areas, Projects, Stages, Tasks, Inbox, Notes & References) and verify every required property, option, relation, and derived field.
- Phase B (User-supplied inputs only): Run only after the full Phase A gate passes for all seven databases. Insert only the supplied records in dependency order (Areas -> Goals -> Projects -> Stages -> Tasks -> Notes & References / Inbox)—here Goals ("launch") then Tasks (the one task)—checking duplicates and date/hierarchy/state invariants, writing relations only in native properties, and verifying persisted records.

2. What can be created right now
- No new databases can be created right now while has_more=true hides existing databases.
- Do not create duplicate Projects or Tasks.
- Do not fabricate the Days Remaining formula body, do not substitute a non-native property for Goals.Status without verification, do not create an 8th database for Google Drive, do not copy the source-workspace-specific template, and do not create templates or sample data.
- Do not insert the "launch" goal or the task yet.
- Safe immediate actions only: finish paginating the search to has_more=false, reconcile verified missing known required properties on existing Projects if safe and within scope, record verified destination IDs in operation evidence, and request (a) read access to Tasks, (b) the verified Days Remaining formula body, and (c) confirmation/verification of native Goals.Status configuration.

3. When input records are inserted
- Hold Phase B completely until Phase A passes for all seven required databases (pagination complete with has_more=false, Tasks readable and verified, required Days Remaining formula resolved and verified, native Goals.Status verified, and all seven live schemas re-read and confirmed).
- Do not insert "launch" or the task early to beat the two-minute review deadline, and do not insert them if only Goals and Tasks are verified.
- Once Phase A passes, insert "launch" in Goals first, then the one task in Tasks, with native property links only and post-write verification.

4. Does optional external integration block setup?
- No. The unavailable optional Tasks.Google Drive File external relation does not block Phase A or setup. Use the available native Drive URL property and do not create an 8th database.
- Actual blockers keeping Phase A partial and holding Phase B: incomplete pagination (has_more=true), unreadable Tasks, and unresolved required definitions (Days Remaining formula body; verification of native Goals.Status).
